question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**beyond**" means past or exceeding a certain limit. In this context, it refers to the crackers not being allowed to be loud beyond a specific level. (से परे)
 
• The other options: "**beside**," "**beneath**," and "**behind**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *This meant that these crackers couldn't be loud beyond__ a certain limit and had to be approved by the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Beside (के बगल में):** Means next to or at the side of something. It does not fit this context.
 
• **Beneath (नीचे):** Means directly under something. It is not suitable for describing levels of loudness.
 
• **Behind (पीछे):** Means at the back of something or in the past. It doesn't fit the context of describing limits.
